record.question: The driver did not accede at the demand of the people as he was aware of risk involved in it.
options: was not accede at the demand
did not accede to the demand
record.explanation: Answer C: did not accede to the demand. The verb “accede” takes “to” before the thing agreed to or accepted. Independent check: The verb “accede” takes the preposition “to”: “accede to the demand.” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/accede. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
